vulns.description: Flask vulnerable to possible disclosure of permanent session cookie due to missing Vary: Cookie header. When a response containing data intended for one client is cached and served to other clients, this can leak sensitive session information.

Werkzeug DoS: high resource usage when parsing multipart/form-data containing a large part with CR/LF character at the beginning. This is a major version bump and changes the signature of several utilities.
Deserialization of untrusted data in IPC and Parquet readers in PyArrow allows arbitrary code execution. Major version jump required; breaking API changes in parquet reader signature.
NULL pointer dereference when loading PKCS7 certificates. Straightforward patch bump within the 41.x line.

sqlparse contains a regular expression denial of service when parsing deeply nested comments. No patched version is available; upstream maintainer has not released a fix. Workarounds include input length limits or switching parsers for the affected code paths.
